usage: cox runs recover [-h] --repo REPO [--runs-dir RUNS_DIR] [--profile PROFILE] [--dry-run]
                        run_id task_id

positional arguments:
  run_id
  task_id

options:
  -h, --help           show this help message and exit
  --repo REPO
  --runs-dir RUNS_DIR  override: resolve task records here instead of the profile's workspace_dir
  --profile PROFILE
  --dry-run            print the merge that would be made and exit without touching anything
